name: titan-gev
description: Gated host for the open source God's Eye View globe, embedded as a tab in the TITAN dashboard.

scripts.upstream:build: cd .upstream && PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=1 npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && CESIUM_ION_TOKEN=__GEV_CESIUM_ION_TOKEN__ npx vite build
scripts.dev:codespace: cd .upstream && HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=4173 npm run dev
